_comment: Ground truth for target-17-cloud-api (synthetic). Hybrid RAG pipeline: local HuggingFace embeddings + cloud LLM generation. Tests tools that span both HF-transformers patterns (from_pretrained, SentenceTransformer) AND cloud-API patterns (ChatOpenAI, ChatAnthropic). aibomgen-cli detects only the python_literal HF models; akumar-aibom detects only the python_literal cloud-API models; jorisbot-aibom and trusera-aibom should detect both.
